correctness.rationale: For each maximal threshold induced vertex set of T_n, the corresponding selected K_n-edge graph has exactly one triangle-plus-spokes component and disjoint matching edges covering all n base vertices. Its bivariate enumeration is a designated-root triple count corrected precisely for the zero-spoke case. The coefficient ratio decreases strictly and the last correction only decreases it further. A fresh standalone forbidden-fourvertex enumerator exhaustively counted every admissible selected subset for n=3,...,8 (74,533 valid subsets; 5,501 maximal) and matched the complete predicted polynomials. The general proof is not inferred from the finite test.

value.rationale: The natural cardinality distribution of inclusion-maximal induced threshold subgraphs (equivalently complements of minimal threshold-deletion sets) in the vertex-transitive triangular family was not determined by existing scalar or algorithmic literature. The exact involution transform exposes a parity-specific correction and yields an all-order bivariate EGF and strictly log-concave nonzero coefficients; it is a complete motivated enumeration. Its reliance on a strong old structural classification is candidly limited, not ignored.
